// Java 8 code
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class Main {

    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];
    static long[] totalarea = new long[100];
    static long[] revarea = new long[100];
    static long[] blockarea = new long[100][100];
    static long[] dp = new long[100][100];
    static long[] bp = new long[100][100];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 40; j++) {
                if (j > i) {
                    ncr[i][j] = 0;
                    continue;
                }
                if (j == 0 || j == i) {
                    ncr[i][j] = 1;
                    continue;
                }
                ncr[i][j] = ncr[i - 1][j - 1] + ncr[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long R = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        long C = Long.parseLong(input[1]);
        String str = br.readLine();
        long n = R + C;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                blockarea[i][j] = ncr[i][R - 1] * ncr[j][R - 1];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                totalarea[i] = 0;
                if (i == 0 || j == 0) continue;
                totalarea[i] = totalarea[i - 1] + totalarea[i - 1][j] - totalarea[i - 1][j - 1];
                totalarea[i] += blockarea[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                revarea[i] = totalarea[n] - totalarea[n - i][n] - totalarea[n][n - j] + totalarea[n - i][n - j];
            }
        }
        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 4);
        Map<Long, Long>[] dpMap = new HashMap[(int) n + 1];
        Map<Long, Long>[] bpMap = new HashMap[(int) n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dpMap[i] = new HashMap<>();
            bpMap[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
        dpMap[0].put(0L, 1L);
        bpMap[0].put(0L, 1L);
        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dpMap[x].entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[n][y + 1] - totalarea[x][y + 1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        dpMap[x].put(entry.getKey() + totalarea[n][y + 1] - totalarea[x][y + 1], dpMap[x].get(entry.getKey()) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 1) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : bpMap[x].entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[n][n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[n - x][n - (y + 1)];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        bpMap[x].put(entry.getKey() + totalarea[n][n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[n - x][n - (y + 1)], bpMap[x].get(entry.getKey()) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dpMap[x].entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[x + 1][n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        dpMap[x + 1].put(c, dpMap[x + 1].getOrDefault(c, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 1) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[n - x][n - y] - totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : bpMap[x].entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() + newarea > m2) continue;
                        bpMap[x + 1].put(entry.getKey() + newarea, bpMap[x + 1].getOrDefault(entry.getKey() + newarea, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) dpMap[x].clear();
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) bpMap[x].clear();
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            long y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dpMap[x].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                // bp[n-x][n-y]
                bestfreq += freq * bpMap[n - x][n - y].getOrDefault(m1 - c, 0L);
                if (m1 != m2) bestfreq += freq * bpMap[n - x][n - y].getOrDefault(m2 - c, 0L);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
